feature_definitions.return_1h: Log close return over the last completed hour
feature_definitions.return_24h: Log close return over the last 24 hours
feature_definitions.return_7d: Log close return over the last 168 hours
feature_definitions.return_30d: Log close return over the last 720 hours
feature_definitions.lookback_return: Log close return over the configured look-back window
feature_definitions.volatility_24h: Standard deviation of hourly log returns, last 24 hours
feature_definitions.volatility_7d: Standard deviation of hourly log returns, last 168 hours
feature_definitions.lookback_volatility: Standard deviation of hourly log returns over the look-back window
feature_definitions.range_24h: Mean (high - low) / close over the last 24 hours
feature_definitions.volume_24h_vs_7d: Log ratio of mean BTC base volume, 24 hours vs 168 hours
feature_definitions.volume_7d_vs_lookback: Log ratio of mean BTC base volume, 168 hours vs look-back window
feature_definitions.quote_volume_24h_vs_7d: Log ratio of mean USDT quote volume, 24 hours vs 168 hours
feature_definitions.taker_fraction_24h: Taker-buy BTC volume / BTC volume, last 24 hours
feature_definitions.log_trades_24h: log(1 + mean hourly trade count), last 24 hours

model.probability_method: Empirical chronological calibration residual distribution; exact zero mass retained
model.interval_method: Horizon-specific chronological residual 10th/90th percentiles; pointwise, not simultaneous
